note: TWO ADD-ONS RETIRED AND FOUR CAPS RAISED, ACROSS TWO REPOS IN ONE PASS. The founder made two decisions and this ticket is both of them: "lets not put cap on users that badly" (contact caps become 500 / 500 / 2,000 / 4,000 for Free / Individual / Small Team / Ministry) and "remove the campus addon. let them add as many as they want" (maxChurches becomes UNLIMITED_CAP on every PAID tier, and the Campus add-on is deleted). The Contacts +500 pack goes with it, `CONTACTS_PER_PACK` and all, and Unlimited Contacts - the only remaining contact add-on - is repriced $40 to $30 monthly and $480 to $360 annual. DODO WAS ALREADY DONE BY THE FOUNDER AND THIS TICKET CALLS NO DODO API: all nine live plan products carry AI Assistant and Admin Seat, Ministry adds Unlimited Contacts, and Campus and Contacts +500 are DETACHED from every one of the nine. The job was to make the code and the marketing site agree with what Dodo already holds - before this, the site advertised five add-ons and two of them could not be bought. FREE STAYS AT maxChurches: 0, AND THAT IS A DECISION, REPORTED. The founder's sentence was about the ADD-ON, and free has never been able to buy it or hold a campus at all. Three things follow from 0 that do not follow from raising it: `hasFeature` reads 0 as falsy, which is what keeps `getMinPlanForFeatureCell('maxChurches')` answering 'plus' rather than deleting the row from every plan-comparison surface that derives from it; the matrix has said 'a free tenant is one evangelist, not a multi-campus ministry' since THE-200; and campuses become the one thing paying buys that free cannot have, which is what the AdminChurches refusal now says in words instead of offering a product. 🔴 THE THING THAT WOULD HAVE TRIPPED THIS TICKET UP: uncapping `maxChurches` SWITCHES ON A DORMANT $10/mo PER-CHURCH BILLING PATH. AdminChurches carried `isMinistry = maxChurches === -1`, false on every tier since the `ultra` tier was deleted, gating a header subtitle printing a running dollar total, a confirm dialog reading 'Confirm & Add Church ($10/mo)', a 'adding $10/mo to your subscription' notice and calls to /api/churches/add-billing and /api/churches/remove-billing. The server half refuses unconditionally - it tests `plan !== 'ultra'` and no tenant can be `ultra` - so the screen would have promised a charge, said the charge had been applied, and no charge would have existed. That is not a latent bug this ticket passed; it is the direct consequence of the one cell this ticket changes, so the whole client path is DELETED. The two API routes are left byte-identical: they are unreachable from this screen now, they already decline, and deleting a money-path route is a larger change than this mandate. A RETIRED KEY IN A TENANT DOCUMENT IS SAFE BY CONSTRUCTION, AND NO MIGRATION WAS WRITTEN. `readTenantAddons` names the three fields it wants and reads them off the untrusted value; it never enumerates the document's own keys, so a stale `campuses: 2` or `contactPacks: 3` is not read at all - it cannot throw and it cannot grant. That is asserted at every layer: the reader, `getEffectiveFeatures` cell-for-cell against an empty set, TenantContext's render, and the member-cap enforcement point, where a document claiming ten packs (worth +5,000 contacts under the old model) is refused on its tier's own 500. All three tenants are the founder's own tests, so in practice nobody holds one. NO CAP WAS LOWERED, asserted directly against the pre-THE-370 numbers, so the question of a tenant already over a cap does not arise. ADMINDASHBOARD.TSX IS BYTE-IDENTICAL TO MAIN, AND THAT IS A MEASURED DECISION RATHER THAN AN OVERSIGHT. Its Campuses nav entry reads `features.maxChurches === 1 ? 'Campus' : 'Campuses'`, and no tier is 1 any more, so the singular branch is now UNREACHABLE - the label renders 'Campuses' on all four tiers with or without an edit, which is why the nav-label tests in this ticket assert the plural and pass against an untouched file. Deleting the dead branch would have been a one-expression cleanup costing appends to ELEVEN accepted-digest sets (THE-292, THE-305, THE-319, THE-325, the-276, the-283, the-290, the-294, the-299, the-302 and AdminDocs.persistent-tree), which is the disproportion THE-111 already measured on this exact file and split out for. The behaviour this ticket is responsible for is correct without it; the dead branch is named as a follow-up instead.

entries.why: THE-370 narrows TWO FIXTURES in this file from five add-on meanings to three, and corrects the comment that explains where the live ids came from. The meanings loop that asserts `addonIdFor(meaning, 'quarterly') === addonIdFor(meaning, 'monthly')` drops 'campus' and 'contactPack'; the LIVE_MONTHLY transcription drops the two matching ids. THE FILE'S SUBJECT IS COMPLETELY UNAFFECTED, which is why this is a fixture edit and not a rewrite: the claim is that a QUARTERLY plan buys its add-ons from the MONTHLY column, because Dodo charges an add-on on its product's own cycle and a quarterly product bills as three monthly cycles. That reconciliation is byte-identical, `addonPeriodFor` is untouched, and the assertion that the table grew no third column - which would be ids Dodo does not have - still runs over every row that remains. The retired rows were never quarterly-specific; they were two of the five meanings the loop happened to walk. WHY THE ROWS ARE GONE RATHER THAN SKIPPED: the founder DETACHED Campus and Contacts +500 from all nine live plan products, so neither is purchasable and both meanings left `DODO_ADDON_MEANINGS` entirely - a skipped row here would be a fixture naming a meaning the type no longer has, which would not compile. The comment above LIVE_MONTHLY now records that the three remaining ids are the whole attachment rather than a subset of five. No price moved in this file and none is written in it; Unlimited Contacts was repriced in Dodo on the same id, which is exactly why the id pins here still hold.

THE-370 re-transcribes TWO NUMBERS in one assertion in this file and adds the note saying why. The test samples load-bearing feature cells across all four tiers to prove that THE-222's REPRICE moved prices and not entitlements; two of the cells it samples are `getPlanFeatures('plus').maxContacts` and `getPlanFeatures('pro').maxContacts`, which THE-370 raised from 150 to 500 and from 500 to 2,000 on the founder's instruction ("lets not put cap on users that badly"). THE-222'S OWN CLAIM IS UNTOUCHED AND IS NOT WEAKENED BY THIS. A cap change is a different kind of edit from a reprice, and THE-370 moves NO PRICE: the nine plan prices are asserted unchanged elsewhere in this very file, and the cross-repo price contract still throws at module scope during the marketing site's prerender if the two repos disagree on any of them. The two numbers are transcribed to their current values rather than the assertion being relaxed to a range or dropped, so this row keeps guarding every OTHER cell it names - free's fundraising and newsFeed, free's own 500, plus's maxAdmins and fundraising, pro's checkInSystem, max's communityGroups and customBranding - exactly as before. NOTHING ELSE IN THIS FILE MOVED: the Dodo product-id pins, the discount derivations, the headline contract and the comment-stripped source sweeps are all byte-identical.

THE-370 touches TWO THINGS in this file: the live add-on id pin narrows from five products to three, and the feature-matrix digest is REPINNED through this file's own documented append path, with the reason recorded and the old digest kept. THE ID PIN: the founder detached Campus and Contacts +500 from all nine live plan products, so their four ids left `DODO_LIVE_ADDONS` and the fixture follows. The three that remain are asserted BYTE-FOR-BYTE UNCHANGED, and that is the property worth having here rather than a weaker one - Unlimited Contacts was REPRICED in Dodo at the same time ($40 to $30 monthly, $480 to $360 annual) on the SAME two product ids, so this pin is now actively proving that a reprice in the processor did not re-point an id, which is the exact failure mode ('an id transposed is a real card charged for the wrong product') the assertion was written for. THE DIGEST: the matrix hash moves because `maxContacts` goes 150/500/2,000 to 500/2,000/4,000 and `maxChurches` goes 1 to -1 on all three paid tiers. The file's own instruction is followed literally - 'if a later ticket legitimately does, update this digest and the per-cell contract in plan-features.test.ts together' - and both moved in this commit. The previous digest is APPENDED to a Previous pins list rather than overwritten, matching how THE-335 recorded its own repin here. 🔴 THE-248'S CLAIM IS UNTOUCHED: it is a REPRICE and still moves no feature cell, and NO PRICE MOVED IN THIS TICKET - asserted directly in this file and enforced across repos by the prerender contract.

THE-370 re-transcribes ONE NUMBER in this file and adds the note saying why: the Ministry cap enumeration asserts `max.maxContacts`, which this ticket raises from 2,000 to 4,000. THE-343'S CLAIM IS NOT MERELY UNTOUCHED BUT STRENGTHENED. That ticket cut Ministry's price (80/216/760 to 60/162/564) and its guard exists to prove a price CUT took nothing away from the tier - 'a price is not an entitlement'. THE-370 moves the cap in the opposite direction from the one that guard fears: the number went UP, never down, so the tenant this test protects is strictly better off than when the assertion was written. `maxAdmins` and `maxCourses` are byte-identical at 15 and 15, and the derived boolean sweep that proves max is still the top tier on every capability runs unchanged over the whole feature set. NOTHING ELSE IN THIS FILE MOVED: the nine plan prices, the BEFORE table recording what Ministry's price WAS, the live-versus-app minor-unit checks per term, the trial-and-interval assertions and the PLATFORM_FEE_MAP pin are all untouched. NO PRICE MOVED IN THIS TICKET - the cross-repo contract would throw at prerender if one had.
